analysis:
Examined both protocol excerpts, threat-model metadata and all threat-model additions. The complete range map identifies only protocol line 1445 as changed within these excerpts: adding addon_hold to Autopilot busy reasons introduces no demonstrated security regression. Surrounding contracts preserve encrypted-only requests (1136), receipt nonce/scope/connection checks (1094–1107), model-switch admission fencing (978–1017), and consent versus serving authorization separation (1499–1519), relevant to A-001, A-003, T-008, T-041 and T-052/T-053.
The threat-model patch adds proposed A-018/TB-012/T-059, documenting a new local availability-control surface, same-UID limitations, per-request signature checks, bounded IPC, persisted leases and machine-lock fallback. These additions do not establish that their claimed implemented controls exist. No executable implementation or contradictory evidence is supplied, so neither a control failure nor its absence can be reported as a finding.
Integration must verify ProviderCore/Addon/{AddonPeerPolicy.swift,AddonIPCServer.swift,ProviderLoop+AddonHold.swift} and Service/ProviderDrain.swift against docs/threat-model.yaml:811–841 and 2305–2337: peer identity binding, framing/time limits, restart restoration, lease/lock races, unloading and admission ownership through reconnect/update/release. Confirm continued App Attest control handling and accepted-work termination (T-010, T-053, T-057), plus registration/heartbeat busy encoding in CoordinatorClient+Registration.swift and ProviderProtocolCodec. Coordinator interpretation is explicitly separate platform work; the protocol patch at 171–195 describes same-connection resumption without provider_drain, so compatibility and exclusion before the first heartbeat remain unverified contracts, not proven regressions. Coverage is limited to these supplied documentation units and selected canonical details.
